home_copy.title: Welcome to our home in Premantura
home_copy.intro: We are Sanja Volner and Matej Abramović. Matej’s Angels is our family kennel of Cavalier King Charles Spaniels and Pomeranians, registered under FCI 103/21.
home_copy.story_title: Dogs first. Part of the family.
home_copy.story_text: Our story began with Bernese Mountain Dogs and an Irish Setter, before Cavaliers and, later, Pomeranians joined us. Here we share their photographs, recorded results and the litters we have raised.
home_copy.album_text: Quiet afternoons, company on the sofa, and the dogs who make our home their own.
home_copy.visit_text: Tell us about the dog or litter you are interested in. If you would like to visit, contact us first so we can arrange a time.

home_copy.poms_alt: Pomeranians relaxing together on the sofa

hr.footer_intro: Obiteljska uzgajivačnica kavalira i pomeranaca Sanje i Mateja u Premanturi.

home_copy.title: Dobrodošli u naš dom u Premanturi
home_copy.intro: Mi smo Sanja Volner i Matej Abramović. Matej’s Angels naša je obiteljska uzgajivačnica Cavalier King Charles španijela i pomeranaca, registrirana pod FCI brojem 103/21.
home_copy.story_text: Naša je priča počela s bernskim planinskim psima i irskom setericom, prije nego što su nam se pridružili kavaliri, a zatim i pomeranci. Ovdje dijelimo njihove fotografije, zabilježene rezultate i legla koja su odrasla kod nas.
home_copy.album_text: Mirna poslijepodneva, društvo na kauču i psi koji su naš dom učinili svojim.
home_copy.visit_title: Imate pitanje ili želite doći u posjet?
home_copy.visit_text: Napišite nam koji vas pas ili leglo zanima. Ako nas želite posjetiti, javite nam se unaprijed da dogovorimo termin.
